# Get Playlist

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Retrieves a playlist.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getPlaylist(name: <#Playlist (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getPlaylist(name: Recently Played)
~~~~
